groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike high-sugar confectionery bars and chocolate pastries, this cheese bread offers higher protein content relative to its simple carbohydrate baseline.
groups.message: This cheese bread provides a more substantial baked option with balanced protein and moderate caloric load compared to dense sugary chocolate bars and sweet topping pies. Enjoy in moderation as part of a balanced daily energy intake.
groups.orderingTip: Pair with unsweetened tea or coffee without added condensed milk or simple syrups to avoid spiking overall glycemic load during snack time.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution: Sweet Bakery Buns & Pies
groups.comparisonSentence: These sweet bakery items contain elevated refined carbohydrates and added sugars compared to standard grain loaves, posing moderate glycemic challenges.
groups.message: Sweet bakery treats like Polo Buns and Topping Pies feature refined wheat flours, sugars, and butter fillings that elevate blood glucose rapidly. Limit consumption if managing metabolic health or diabetes.
groups.orderingTip: Share the pastry with a companion or limit portion sizes to half to moderate your daily intake of refined sugars and total fats.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert: High Saturated Fat & Sugar Chocolate
groups.comparisonSentence: This milk chocolate bar delivers higher saturated fat and concentrated added sugars per serving than any of the baked bread items.
groups.message: Consuming milk chocolate bars contributes concentrated sugar and saturated fats with minimal dietary fiber or protein. Frequent intake can negatively impact cardiovascular and metabolic profiles.
groups.orderingTip: Opt for smaller portion sizes or choose dark chocolate with higher cocoa content (>70%) to reduce overall sugar exposure.
